body.name: Compact Laplace graph class \(\mathfrak K_G(L_B,\kappa,\beta,s_-,s_+)\)
body.construction: \(\{(B,(s_i)_{i\in V}):\operatorname{supp}(B)=E(G),\; |B_{ji}|\ge\beta\; \forall i\to j,\; \lVert B\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\le L_B,\; \sigma_{\min}(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ge\kappa\; \forall S\in\mathcal I,\; s_i\in[s_-,s_+]\; \forall i,\; \varepsilon_i=s_iZ_i,\; Z_i\stackrel{\mathrm{ind}}{\sim}\operatorname{Laplace}(0,1)\}\).
